diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-1 Identification number
diagrams.description: Location of identification number plate attached to the right-hand side of the 3N71B transmission case.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: The identification plate is attached to the right-hand side of the transmission case above the oil pan rail.

diagrams.caption: Identification of number arrangements
diagrams.description: Illustration of the Jatco identification plate and breakdown of model and serial number designations.
measurements_and_specs: Serial number breakdown: First digit = Last figure denoting year (A.D.); Second digit = Month of production (1-9, X: Oct., Y: Nov., Z: Dec.); Remaining digits = Serial production number for the month
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Month codes: 1-9 for Jan-Sep, X for October, Y for November, Z for December.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-2 Cross-sectional view of 3N71B automatic transmission
diagrams.description: Comprehensive longitudinal cross-sectional cutaway diagram of the 3N71B automatic transmission showing all major internal components from drive plate to output shaft, with bolt tightening torque letter callouts A through I and component numbered callouts 1 through 19.

callouts.A: Converter housing to engine bolts: 4 to 5 kg-m (29 to 36 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Drive plate to crankshaft bolts: 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Torque converter to drive plate bolts: 4.5 to 5.5 kg-m (33 to 40 ft-lb)
callouts.D: Oil pump housing bolts: 0.6 to 0.8 kg-m (4.3 to 5.8 ft-lb)
callouts.E: Oil pan bolts: 0.5 to 0.7 kg-m (3.6 to 5.1 ft-lb)
callouts.F: Rear extension housing bolts: 2.0 to 2.5 kg-m (14 to 18 ft-lb)
callouts.G: Rear mounting crossmember bolts: 1.3 to 1.8 kg-m (9 to 13 ft-lb)
callouts.H: Oil pump to case bolts: 0.55 to 0.75 kg-m (4.0 to 5.4 ft-lb)
callouts.I: Control valve assembly bolts: 0.25 to 0.35 kg-m (1.8 to 2.5 ft-lb)

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure exact torque specifications A through I are observed during reassembly of the transmission casing, oil pump, valve body, and converter housing.

diagrams.caption: Hydraulic control system block diagram
diagrams.description: Block flow diagram illustrating functional relationships between Oil pump, Manual linkage, Vacuum diaphragm, Downshift solenoid, Governor valve, Control valve, Torque converter, Front clutch, Rear clutch, Low and reverse brake, Band brake, and Lubrication circuits.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Shows inputs (oil pump, manual linkage, vacuum diaphragm, downshift solenoid, governor valve) to control valve, and outputs from control valve to clutches, brakes, converter, and lubrication.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-3 Oil pump
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the internal involute gear oil pump showing the housing with crescent, cover, inner drive gear, and outer driven gear.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: The inner gear is driven by the torque converter drive sleeve directly coupled with engine rotation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-4 Manual linkage
diagrams.description: Assembly drawing of manual linkage on transmission case showing manual plate, inhibitor switch, parking rod, and manual shaft.
wiring_and_connections: Starter magnet circuit closed at P and N
Back-up lamp circuit closed at R
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Inhibitor switch prevents starting in gear (allows start in P and N only) and switches reverse lamps in R.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-5 Vacuum diaphragm
diagrams.description: Cross section of vacuum diaphragm unit connected to intake manifold with central rubber partition, return spring, and throttle valve actuator rod.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Vacuum level modulates the throttle valve to adapt shift points and line pressure to engine load.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-6 Downshift solenoid
diagrams.description: Downshift solenoid and kickdown switch mechanism operated by accelerator linkage.
measurements_and_specs: Kickdown switch closes between 7/8 and 15/16 full throttle pedal stroke
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Accelerator pedal must be adjusted properly to guarantee kickdown switch contact at 7/8 to 15/16 travel.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-7 Cross-sectional view of governor
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional drawing of primary and secondary governor valves mounted in the governor body on the output shaft oil distributor.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Primary valve operates as an ON/OFF threshold valve; secondary valve regulates governor pressure in proportion to vehicle speed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-8 Output shaft with oil distributor and governor
diagrams.description: Perspective view of the output shaft assembly complete with oil distributor and governor valve body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Located on the output shaft inside the transmission rear extension housing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-9 Exploded view of governor
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the governor assembly showing oil distributor, governor valve body, primary governor valve, secondary governor valve, springs, retainers, and mounting bolts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Valves and springs must move smoothly in their bores without sticking.

diagrams.caption: Flow chart of control valve system
diagrams.description: Flow diagram showing oil flow from pump through regulator valve to throttle valve, manual valve, auxiliary valve, speed change valve, governor valve, and final actuation of clutches and band brake.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Flow chart defines basic hydraulic logic of line pressure distribution.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-10 Pressure regulator valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional diagram of the Pressure Regulator Valve (PRV) showing ports 7 (line pressure), 8, 14 (torque converter), 16 (throttle pressure), 18 (throttle pressure from PMV), orifice 20, orifice 21, spools A and B, and spring.
measurements_and_specs: Circuit (20): Involute pump delivery damping orifice
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Balances pump pressure against spring force modulated by throttle pressure (16, 18) and Reverse line pressure (6). Feeds torque converter circuit (14).

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-11 Manual valve
diagrams.description: Cross section of the manual valve spool indicating selector positions P, R, N, D, 2, 1 and connected line pressure output circuits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 23.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Manually shifted spool selects port alignment for P, R, N, D, 2, and 1 ranges. Drains inactive circuits.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-12 "1st-2nd" shift valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic of 1st-2nd shift valve (FSV) showing spool, spring, and hydraulic ports 1, 5, 8, 11, 12, 13, 15.
measurements_and_specs: Port 12: Low and reverse brake feed
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Governor pressure on port 15 acts against line pressure and spring force to shift from 1st to 2nd.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-13 "2nd-3rd" shift valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional view of 2nd-3rd shift valve (SSV) showing spool, readjust plug, orifice checking valve 24, and hydraulic connections 3, 6, 10, 13, 15, 16, 19.
measurements_and_specs: Port 10: Front clutch / band servo release feed
Port 13: Kickdown line pressure from SDV
Port 19: Regulated throttle pressure to SSV/FSV
diagrams.mechanic_notes: SSV connects port 3 to port 10 to engage front clutch and release band servo for 3rd gear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-14 Pressure modifier valve
diagrams.description: Cross section of Pressure Modifier Valve (PMV) showing spool, ports 15, 16, 18, and drain ports.
measurements_and_specs: Port 18: Modified throttle pressure to PRV top
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Governor pressure modulates PMV to direct throttle pressure (18) to PRV to reduce line pressure at cruising speeds.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-15 Vacuum throttle valve
diagrams.description: Cross section of vacuum throttle valve (VTV) connected to vacuum diaphragm actuator, showing ports 7 (line pressure), 16 (throttle pressure), and 17 (drain / back-up pressure).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Modulates line pressure to throttle pressure (16) proportional to engine manifold depression.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-16 Throttle back-up valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional view of Throttle Back-Up Valve (TBV) showing ports 4, 12, 17, and drain.
measurements_and_specs: Port 4: Line pressure in ranges 2 and 1
Port 12: Line pressure in range 1 low
Port 17: Back-up pressure output to VTV
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Supplies back-up pressure to VTV in manual ranges 2 and 1 to boost line pressure.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-17 Solenoid downshift valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic of solenoid downshift valve (SDV) showing electromagnetic solenoid, plunger, spring, and ports 4, 7, 13.
measurements_and_specs: Port 13: Kickdown pressure circuit to FSV and SSV
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Electromagnetic plunger forces valve downward when kickdown switch closes, routing line pressure (7) to circuit (13).

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-18 Second lock valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional diagram of second lock valve (SLV) showing ports 2, 3, 8, 9, and spring.
measurements_and_specs: Port 3: Line pressure in D range
diagrams.mechanic_notes: In range 2, line pressure (2) locks valve downward to keep band servo engaged regardless of FSV position.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-19 "2nd-3rd" timing valve
diagrams.description: Cross section of 2nd-3rd timing valve (TMV) showing ports 10, 11, 15, 16, bypass passage, orifice 22, and spring.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Under low throttle / high vehicle speed, TMV routes line pressure through orifice 22 to soften front clutch engagement.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-20 Control valve
diagrams.description: Plan view layout of the complete control valve body assembly showing relative physical locations and bore orientations of all 10 hydraulic control and shift valves.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Reference this layout when disassembling and assembling the valve body to verify spool and spring orientation in each bore.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-21 Identification of oil channels in oil pump
diagrams.description: Port diagram on the rear face of the oil pump housing showing oil pump discharge hole (7), torque converter pressure (14), rear clutch pressure (1), front clutch pressure (11), and oil pump suction hole.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Identify matching oil passages between oil pump rear face and transmission case front face during assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-22 Identification of oil channels in case front face
diagrams.description: Oil passage layout on the transmission case front face mating with oil pump housing, showing ports 1, 7, 11, 14, air breather, and suction hole.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure air breather is clear and oil pump gasket correctly aligns with all indicated holes.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-23 Identification of oil channels in case face
diagrams.description: Oil passage identification on the lower transmission case face mating with the control valve assembly.
components: Transmission case valve body mating surface
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Crucial passage reference for diagnosis and valve body gasket positioning.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-24 Parking mechanism
diagrams.description: Mechanical engagement views of the parking pawl with the oil distributor park gear showing 'Free' and 'Lock' states and operating rod cam linkage.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: In 'Lock', the parking rod cam drives pawl into oil distributor teeth to mechanically lock output shaft.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-25 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "P" range (Park)
diagrams.description: Full hydraulic circuit diagram in 'P' (Park) range showing line pressure (7) applied to manual valve, routed via line 4 to SDV and TBV, and line 5 to FSV, line 12 to Low & Reverse brake, and torque converter supply (14) while other clutches and band servo are drained.
measurements_and_specs: Active hydraulic circuits: Line 7 (pump delivery), Line 4 (SDV/TBV), Line 5 & 12 (Low & reverse brake), Line 14 (converter/lube), Line 16 (throttle pressure)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: In Park range, Low & Reverse brake is hydraulically applied along with mechanical locking pawl engagement. Red = Line pressure, Blue = Throttle pressure, Pink = Torque converter pressure, Light blue = Governor pressure, X = Drain.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-26 Power transmission during "R" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway perspective diagram illustrating torque and power flow through input shaft, front clutch, sun gear, rear planetary gears, connecting drum, rear internal gear, and output shaft during Reverse range operation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Input shaft rotates clockwise; front clutch and low & reverse brake engaged; output shaft rotates counterclockwise.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-27 Operation of each mechanism during "R" range
diagrams.description: Schematic representation of engaged friction elements in Reverse range showing front clutch applied, band brake released (release side pressurized), and low & reverse brake applied.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Front clutch: ON; Rear clutch: OFF; Band brake: RELEASE (ON); Low & reverse brake: ON; One-way clutch: INACTIVE.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-28 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "R" range (Reverse)
diagrams.description: Full hydraulic schematic in Reverse range showing line pressure (7) directed through manual valve (2) into circuits (5) and (6), pressurizing circuit (12) for Low & Reverse brake and circuit (10) for Front clutch and band servo release side.
measurements_and_specs: Active hydraulic circuits: Line 7, Line 5, Line 6, Line 10 (Front clutch & band release), Line 12 (Low & reverse brake), Line 14 (torque converter)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Line pressure (6) assists spring on PRV to boost line pressure to maximum for heavy reverse torque transmission.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-29 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "N" range (Neutral)
diagrams.description: Full hydraulic schematic in 'N' (Neutral) range showing line pressure (7) regulated by PRV (1), delivered to manual valve (2) with all output circuits (1 through 6) blocked/drained, while circuit (14) supplies torque converter and lubrication.
measurements_and_specs: Active hydraulic circuits: Line 7 (regulated line pressure), Line 14 (converter feed and lubrication), Line 16 (throttle pressure)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: All friction elements (clutches, band brake, low & reverse brake) are unpressurized and drained in Neutral.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-30 Power transmission during "D₁" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway perspective diagram illustrating torque and power transmission through input shaft, rear clutch, front internal gear, front planetary gears, sun gear, rear planetary gears, one-way clutch, rear internal gear, and output shaft during D1 low gear operation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: One-way clutch prevents rear planetary carrier counterclockwise rotation, enabling low gear torque multiplication.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-31 Operation of each mechanism during "D₁" range
diagrams.description: Schematic representation of engaged friction elements in D1 low gear showing rear clutch applied and one-way clutch holding, with front clutch, band brake, and low & reverse brake released.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch: ON; One-way clutch: ON (holding); Front clutch: OFF; Band brake: OFF; Low & reverse brake: OFF.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-32 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "D₁" range (Low gear)
diagrams.description: Full hydraulic schematic in D1 (Low gear) range showing line pressure (7) routed through manual valve (2) into circuits (1), (2), and (3), applying Rear clutch and feeding governor valve, while 1st-2nd shift valve remains in low position.
measurements_and_specs: Active hydraulic circuits: Line 7, Line 1 (Rear clutch and governor feed), Line 2 (to SLV), Line 3 (to SSV and SLV), Line 14 (converter and lubrication), Line 15 (governor pressure build-up), Line 16 (throttle pressure)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch is engaged by circuit 1; governor valve begins generating speed-dependent pressure in line 15 to oppose FSV return spring.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-33 Power transmission during "D₂" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway diagram showing the power flow path through the transmission during D2 range (2nd gear).

callouts.D2: Applied band brake and power flow path

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch is applied; band brake holds front clutch drum, connecting shell, and sun gear from rotating.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-34 Operation of each mechanism during "D₂" range
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic illustration of engaged components during D2 range (2nd gear).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch and band brake are engaged; one-way clutch freewheels clockwise.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-35 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "D₂" range (2nd gear)
diagrams.description: Complete schematic oil pressure circuit diagram during D2 range (2nd gear). Line pressure is directed through manual valve at D position to rear clutch and through shifted 1st-2nd shift valve and second lock valve to band servo apply side.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: 1st-2nd shift valve moves to introduce line pressure (1) to line pressure (8), then via second lock valve to line pressure (9) locking the band servo apply side.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-36 Power transmission during "D₃" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway diagram showing power transmission in D3 range (top gear). Both front and rear clutches are engaged, locking the planetary gearset together for 1:1 direct drive.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Both front and rear clutches engaged; planetary gearing rotates as a solid unit to provide direct 1:1 ratio.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-37 Operation of each mechanism "D₃" range
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic illustration of engaged components in D3 range (top gear).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Front clutch and rear clutch engaged; band servo release side pressurized to release the band brake.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-38 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "D₃" range (Top gear)
diagrams.description: Complete schematic oil pressure circuit diagram during D3 range (top gear). Governor pressure shifts 2nd-3rd shift valve, directing line pressure (10) to engage front clutch and to the release side of band servo.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Line pressure (10) pressurizes front clutch and release side of band servo, overcoming apply pressure and releasing band brake.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-39 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "D" range kickdown (shift valves in 2nd gear position)
diagrams.description: Oil pressure circuit diagram showing D range kickdown operation with shift valves shifted to the 2nd gear position. Solenoid downshift valve is actuated, delivering kickdown pressure (13) to assist the 2nd-3rd shift valve spring against governor pressure.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Downshift solenoid pushes downshift valve downward to open line pressure (7) to circuit (13), overcoming governor pressure (15) to achieve immediate downshift.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-40 Power transmission during "2" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway diagram showing power flow in 2 range (locked 2nd gear). Front clutch drum and sun gear held stationary by band brake; rear clutch engaged.

callouts.2: Applied band brake and power flow path

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Gear ratio is locked in 2nd forward speed regardless of vehicle speed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-41 Operation of each mechanism during "2" range
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic illustration of engaged components in 2 range (2nd gear locked).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch engaged, band brake applied.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-42 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "2" range (2nd gear)
diagrams.description: Oil pressure circuit diagram for 2 range (2nd gear). Manual valve in '2' position directs line pressure (2) to lock the second lock valve and feed the apply side of the band servo, keeping 2nd gear locked regardless of speed.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Line pressure (2) hydraulically locks the second lock valve, fixing the transmission in 2nd gear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-43 Power transmission during "1₁" range
diagrams.description: Cutaway diagram showing power transmission in 1_1 range (low gear). Rear clutch is engaged and low & reverse brake is applied to hold the connecting drum and rear planet carrier stationary.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch engaged, low and reverse brake applied to hold rear planet carrier.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-44 Operation of each mechanism during "1₁" range
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional schematic illustration of engaged components in 1_1 range (low gear).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rear clutch engaged, low & reverse brake applied; front clutch and band brake disengaged.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-45 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "1₁" range (Low gear)
diagrams.description: Oil pressure circuit diagram for 1_1 range (low gear). Manual valve in '1' position directs line pressure (5) through 1st-2nd shift valve into circuit (12) to actuate the low and reverse brake.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Line pressure (12) assists the 1st-2nd shift valve spring to prevent upshift until governor pressure reaches very high speeds.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-46 Oil pressure circuit diagram — "1₂" range (2nd gear)
diagrams.description: Oil pressure circuit diagram for 1_2 range (2nd gear overspeed protection). When vehicle speed exceeds safety limit in 1 range, high governor pressure overcomes line pressure (12) and shifts the 1st-2nd shift valve to release low & reverse brake and apply band servo.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Automatic upshift to 2nd gear occurs at high speed in 1 range to prevent engine over-revolution.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-47 Removing torque converter attaching bolts
diagrams.description: Technician using a wrench through the lower converter housing access opening to remove the torque converter-to-drive plate attaching bolts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Scribe match marks on torque converter and drive plate before removal so they can be replaced in original orientation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-48 Measuring drive plate runout
diagrams.description: Dial gauge setup positioned against drive plate while turning crankshaft one full turn to measure drive plate runout.
measurements_and_specs: Replace drive plate limit: > 0.5 mm (0.020 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rotate crankshaft one full turn to measure runout. Replace drive plate if runout exceeds 0.5 mm (0.020 in).

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-49 Torque converter aligning cut
diagrams.description: Detail view of the torque converter drive hub notch/aligning cut that engages the oil pump drive gear lugs.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Notch in torque converter hub must engage drive flats of oil pump drive gear without force.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-50 Installing torque converter
diagrams.description: Sectional diagram showing measurement of distance 'A' from converter housing front face to converter mounting bolt boss face.

callouts.A: Distance from housing front face to converter bolt boss

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Distance 'A' must exceed 21.5 mm (0.846 in) to confirm the torque converter is fully seated into the oil pump.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-51 Control linkage system
diagrams.description: Complete assembly diagram of the automatic transmission control linkage mechanism with shift gate patterns and tightening torque specifications for each connection point.

callouts.A: Bolt and nut T: 3.0 to 4.0 kg-m (22 to 29 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Adjust nuts T: 0.8 to 1.1 kg-m (5.8 to 8.0 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Knob screws T: 0.2 to 0.25 kg-m (1.4 to 1.8 ft-lb)
callouts.D: Bracket nut T: 0.8 to 1.1 kg-m (5.8 to 8.0 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Bolt and nut A: 3.0 to 4.0 kg-m (22 to 29 ft-lb)
Adjust nuts B: 0.8 to 1.1 kg-m (5.8 to 8.0 ft-lb)
Knob screws C: 0.2 to 0.25 kg-m (1.4 to 1.8 ft-lb)
Bracket nut D: 0.8 to 1.1 kg-m (5.8 to 8.0 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Set both control lever and selector range lever at N position when adjusting selector rod trunnion nuts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-52 Removing oil pan
diagrams.description: Removing oil pan bolts while transmission is mounted on Transmission Case Stand ST07860000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mount transmission on Transmission Case Stand ST07870000 or ST07860000 before removing oil pan.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-53 Downshift solenoid and vacuum diaphragm
diagrams.description: External view of transmission case showing location and removal of downshift solenoid and vacuum diaphragm.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not leave diaphragm rod inside transmission case; rod is assembled in top of vacuum diaphragm.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-54 Removing valve body
diagrams.description: Underside view of transmission case with oil pan removed showing removal of bolts holding control valve body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove bolts holding control valve body to transmission case.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-55 Loosening band servo
diagrams.description: Technician using wrench to loosen lock nut and adjust piston stem on band servo.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten piston stem to hold front clutch drum before withdrawing oil pump; then loosen to remove band strut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-56 Removing oil pump
diagrams.description: Withdrawing oil pump from front of transmission case using Sliding Hammer ST25850000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not allow front clutch to slip out of position and drop onto floor when oil pump is withdrawn.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-57 Removing band strut
diagrams.description: Front view of transmission case interior showing removal of band strut after loosening band servo stem.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove band strut by loosening piston stem further.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-58 Removing connecting shell
diagrams.description: Removing connecting shell, rear clutch hub, and front planetary carrier as an assembled unit.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove connecting shell, rear clutch hub, and front planetary carrier as a unit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-59 Removing snap ring
diagrams.description: Prying snap ring off the output shaft using Snap Ring Remover HT69860000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use Snap Ring Remover HT69860000 to pry snap ring off output shaft.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-60 Removing connecting drum
diagrams.description: Withdrawing connecting drum and internal gear of rear planetary carrier as an assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove connecting drum and inner gear of rear planetary carrier as an assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-61 Removing rear extension
diagrams.description: Removing rear extension housing from transmission case by loosening securing bolts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen securing bolts and withdraw rear extension housing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-62 Removing governor and oil distributor
diagrams.description: Pulling out output shaft and removing oil distributor together with governor valve assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pull out output shaft; remove oil distributor ② together with governor valve ①.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-63 Removing drive and driven plates
diagrams.description: Removing low and reverse brake retaining plate, drive plate, driven plate, and dish plate from transmission case after prying off snap ring.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pry off snap ring using pliers. Remove retaining plate, drive plate, driven plate and dish plate in that order.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-64 Removing hex-head slotted bolt
diagrams.description: Using Hex-head Extension ST25570001 to reach through back side of transmission case and remove hex-head slotted bolts.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Reach through back side of transmission case with special extension ST25570001 to remove slotted bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-65 Removing piston
diagrams.description: Applying compressed air into hole in cylinder to blow out low and reverse brake piston.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Blow out low and reverse brake piston by directing a jet of air into hole in cylinder.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-66 Removing band servo
diagrams.description: Directing a jet of air toward release side of band servo to assist in removing retainer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Direct a jet of air toward release side if difficulty is encountered in removing band servo retainer.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-67 Removing manual plate
diagrams.description: Interior view of linkage components on manual shaft showing parking brake lever, manual plate, and parking rod.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pry snap rings from ends of parking lever, back off lock nut, and remove manual plate and parking rod.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-68 Measuring seal ring to ring groove clearance
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional inspection diagram showing feeler gauge measurement between seal ring and groove in oil distributor.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Correct clearance between seal ring and ring groove is 0.04 to 0.16 mm (0.0016 to 0.0063 in). Replace if worn beyond limits.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-69 Installing one-way clutch inner race
diagrams.description: Torquing hex-head slotted bolt for one-way clutch inner race using special hex extension ST25570001 and torque wrench GG91060000.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 1.3 to 1.8 kg-m (9 to 13 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Torque hex-head slotted bolt to 1.3 to 1.8 kg-m (9 to 13 ft-lb) using special extension and torque wrench.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-70 Measuring ring to plate clearance
diagrams.description: Feeler gauge measuring clearance between snap ring ① and retaining plate ② in low and reverse brake.
measurements_and_specs: Low and reverse brake clearance: 0.80 to 1.25 mm (0.031 to 0.049 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure clearance between snap ring and retaining plate; select appropriate retaining plate thickness.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-71 One-way clutch
diagrams.description: Perspective view of one-way clutch assembly showing orientation arrow mark on outer cage.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install one-way clutch so arrow mark '→' points toward front of vehicle; must rotate freely clockwise only.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-72 Installing planetary carrier
diagrams.description: Technician lowering rear clutch hub and front planetary carrier into position.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install rear clutch hub and front planetary carrier carefully into place.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-73 Installing connecting shell
diagrams.description: Technician installing connecting shell over planetary gearing components.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Assemble connecting shell and parts up to front clutch in reverse order of disassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-74 End play
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional reference diagram illustrating front end play and total end play measurement locations.
measurements_and_specs: Total end play: 0.25 to 0.50 mm (0.010 to 0.020 in)
Front end play: 0.5 to 0.8 mm (0.020 to 0.031 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Diagram showing relationships between thrust washer 1, bearing race 7, oil pump gasket 6, and cases for total and front end play adjustments.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-75 Measuring the distance "A" and "C"
diagrams.description: Sectional diagram showing vernier caliper depth measurement of distances A (to bearing race surface) and C (to thrust washer surface) inside transmission case.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure distance A and C using vernier calipers from front face of transmission case.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-76 Measuring the distance "B" and "D"
diagrams.description: Sectional diagram showing vernier caliper measurement of distances B and D on oil pump cover.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure distance B and D on oil pump cover from mounting flange face.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-77 Measuring the distance "L"
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional diagram illustrating measurement of distance 'L' from transmission case end to vacuum throttle valve rod end with valve fully depressed.

callouts.L: Distance from case end to pushed-in valve rod end

measurements_and_specs: Measured distance L used to select diaphragm rod length (29.0 to 31.0 mm)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Push vacuum throttle valve fully in, measure length L, and select diaphragm rod corresponding to table.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-78 Sectional view of front clutch
diagrams.description: Sectional view of front clutch assembly showing arrangement of piston, return springs, dished plate, driven plates, drive plates, retaining plate, and snap rings.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay close attention to stacking sequence of plates: dished plate first, followed by alternating driven and drive plates, then retaining plate and snap ring.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-79 Removing snap ring
diagrams.description: Using Clutch Spring Compressor ST25420001 to compress springs and Snap Ring Remover ST25320001 to remove snap ring from front clutch spring retainer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Compress return springs evenly with compressor tool before removing snap ring.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-80 Modifying coil spring compressor
diagrams.description: Dimensional modification diagram showing where to grind off hatched portion (1.5 mm deep by 20 mm wide) on legs of Clutch Spring Compressor ST25420000.
measurements_and_specs: Cut off hatched portion: 1.5 mm (0.059 in) by 20 mm (0.079 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: When using older compressor ST25420000, grind 1.5 mm x 20 mm off toe-tips of three legs to clear clutch drum.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-81 Blowing out piston
diagrams.description: Technician using compressed air jet directed into front clutch drum oil hole to blow out piston.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold a shop rag over drum opening when blowing air to catch piston safely.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-82 Inserting clutch plate
diagrams.description: Technician carefully inserting lined drive plates and steel driven plates into front clutch drum.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Dip all clutch plates in clean ATF prior to installation in drum.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-83 Measuring ring to plate clearance
diagrams.description: Feeler gauge measuring clearance between snap ring ① and retaining plate ② in front clutch drum.
measurements_and_specs: Specified clearance: 1.6 to 2.0 mm (0.063 to 0.079 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure clearance with feeler gauge; select from 6 available retaining plates to obtain 1.6 to 2.0 mm clearance.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-84 Testing front clutch
diagrams.description: Functional air check of front clutch mounted on oil pump cover by applying compressed air into oil hole.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: With clutch mounted on oil pump cover, direct air jet into clutch oil hole to verify positive piston engagement.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-85 Sectional view of rear clutch
diagrams.description: Sectional view of rear clutch assembly showing arrangement of rear clutch drum, piston, dished plate, return springs, retainer, plates, and snap rings.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Notice correct orientation of dish plate and stack sequence of drive and driven plates.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-86 Removing snap ring
diagrams.description: Compressing coil spring retainer with tool ST25420001 and removing snap ring with tool ST25320001 from rear clutch drum.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Compress coil springs evenly to release tension from snap ring before prying out.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-87 Blowing out piston
diagrams.description: Applying compressed air into rear clutch drum oil passage to dislodge and remove piston.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Direct a jet of compressed air into oil hole in clutch drum while holding piston with a cloth.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-88 Measuring ring to plate clearance
diagrams.description: Feeler gauge measuring clearance between snap ring ① and retaining plate ② in rear clutch.
measurements_and_specs: Specified clearance: 0.8 to 1.6 mm (0.031 to 0.063 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Specified clearance is 0.8 to 1.6 mm (0.031 to 0.063 in). Adjust using retaining plates if out of spec.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-89 Testing rear clutch
diagrams.description: Bench testing assembled rear clutch on oil pump cover with compressed air.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install rear clutch on oil pump cover and apply air pressure to test positive clutch operation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-90 Testing low & reverse brake
diagrams.description: Directing compressed air into oil passage in transmission case to verify positive engagement of low & reverse brake.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Blow compressed air into oil hole in transmission case to verify definite low & reverse brake application.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-91 Removing piston
diagrams.description: Technician withdrawing servo piston from brake band servo bore.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Blow out servo piston by directing air into release-side hole in piston; inspect piston for score marks.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-92 Sectional view of servo piston
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional engineering view of the transmission case, brake band, and band servo piston mechanism showing apply and release passages and return spring.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extreme care must be taken to avoid damaging the rubber ring when installing seal lace.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-93 Testing piston (Apply side)
diagrams.description: Testing servo piston operation by applying compressed air nozzle into the apply-side passage in transmission case.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Blow compressed air from apply-side of piston to test for definite piston operation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-94 Testing piston (Release side)
diagrams.description: Testing band servo retainer tightness using compressed air while plugging apply hole with thumb.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: With apply-side plugged with thumb, blow air into cylinder from release-side. If retainer raises, attaching bolts are loose.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-95 Testing secondary governor
diagrams.description: Sectional schematic of the governor assembly mounted on output shaft showing primary and secondary governors and air test point A.

callouts.A: Air test port (Line pressure 1 from control valve)

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Blow air under light pressure into hole A; listen for buzzing noise like that of a model plane.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-96 Measuring clearance
diagrams.description: Feeler gauge and straight edge measuring clearance between pump gears and oil pump cover.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Inspect gear teeth for wear or damage before measuring.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-99 Measuring runout
diagrams.description: Dial indicator checking total runout of oil pump cover mounted on assembling gauge ST25580000.
measurements_and_specs: Total indicator reading: within 0.07 mm (0.0028 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check runout before and after tightening securing bolts to 0.6 to 0.8 kg-m (4.3 to 5.8 ft-lb).

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-97 Measuring clearance
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional detail illustrating clearance measurement between seal ring and ring groove.
measurements_and_specs: Standard clearance: 0.04 to 0.16 mm (0.002 to 0.006 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use feeler gauge to measure clearance in groove.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-98 Centering oil pump
diagrams.description: Centering oil pump cover to pump housing using assembling gauge ST25580000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Align converter housing securing bolt holes when installing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-100 Measuring pinion washer to carrier clearance
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional diagram showing feeler gauge measuring clearance between pinion thrust washer and planetary carrier.
measurements_and_specs: Standard clearance: 0.20 to 0.70 mm (0.008 to 0.028 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Planetary carrier cannot be disassembled. If defective, replace as a unit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-101 Disassembling valve body
diagrams.description: Removing oil strainer bolts and nuts from control valve using hexagon wrench HT61000800 and spinner handle HT62350000.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bolts may be removed with screwdriver, but hexagon wrench and spinner handle are recommended.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-102 Removing separate plate
diagrams.description: Lifting separate plate away from control valve body halves.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not allow orifice check valve and valve spring in lower valve body to be scattered and lost.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-103 Removing manual valve
diagrams.description: Sliding manual valve spool out of the control valve body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Handle valve spool carefully to prevent scratching precision surfaces.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-104 Removing side plate
diagrams.description: Using hexagon wrench HT61000800 and spinner handle HT62350000 to remove valve body side plate screws.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Avoid working screws off with ordinary screwdrivers to prevent damaging machine screw heads.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-105 Components parts of control valve
diagrams.description: Exploded layout of all control valve spools, plugs, sleeves, springs, and end plates around the main valve body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Organize parts in a part rack to ensure each valve, plug, and spring returns to its designated bore.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-106 Valve spring
diagrams.description: Dimensional engineering diagram of a valve spring showing wire diameter, mean coil diameter, free length, as-installed length, and tension measurement points.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Compare spring dimensions with the Valve Spring Chart before installation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-107 Installing side plate
diagrams.description: Torqueing side plate screws on valve body using Torque Driver ST25160000 and Hexagon Wrench HT61000800.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 0.25 to 0.35 kg-m (1.8 to 2.5 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten side plates evenly to 0.25 to 0.35 kg-m (1.8 to 2.5 ft-lb).

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-108 Installing valve body
diagrams.description: Securing upper and lower valve bodies together using Torque Driver ST25160000 and Hexagon Wrench HT61000800.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 0.25 to 0.35 kg-m (1.8 to 2.5 ft-lb)
Reamer bolt torque: 0.5 to 0.7 kg-m (3.6 to 5.1 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note difference in tightening torque between standard valve body bolts and reamer bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-109 Position of check valve and spring
diagrams.description: Plan view of valve body maze passages showing exact locations of throttle relief valve and two orifice check valves.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure orifice check valves and relief springs are correctly positioned before joining valve body sections.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-110 Downshift solenoid
diagrams.description: Location of the electric downshift solenoid threaded into the side of the transmission case above the oil pan rail.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Watch for oil leakage around solenoid threads in transmission case.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-111 Construction of inhibitor switch
diagrams.description: Exploded mounting assembly of inhibitor switch, manual shaft, washers, nuts, manual plate, and range select lever.
wiring_and_connections: Inhibitor switch wire harness (BY, RB wires)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Align switch body with manual shaft in 'N' range using 1.5 mm (0.059 in) pin.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-112 Shift Schedule
diagrams.description: Shift schedule graph plotting negative intake manifold vacuum (-mmHg / -inHg) against output shaft speed (rpm) and car speed (km/h and MPH) for upshifts (1->2, 2->3) and downshifts (3->2, 2->1, 1_2->1_1) including kickdown range.
measurements_and_specs: Car speed: 0 to 120 km/h (0 to 80 MPH)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use this graph to verify upshift and downshift vehicle speeds under varying engine vacuum loads.

diagrams.caption: Fig. AT-113 Measuring Line Pressure
diagrams.description: Transmission case illustration showing the locations of test ports 1 (Line pressure), 2 (Governor pressure), and 3 (Servo release pressure) with gauge connected.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove blind plugs to connect pressure gauge for test measurements.

troubleshooting.symptom: Drive plate runout excessive
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Bent or damaged drive plate
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace drive plate if runout exceeds 0.5 mm (0.020 in)

troubleshooting.symptom: Transmission binds or rotates stiffly after torque converter installation
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Torque converter notch not engaged properly with oil pump
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check that distance 'A' is more than 21.5 mm (0.846 in) and reinstall converter aligning notches properly

troubleshooting.symptom: Torque converter oil fouled or contaminated due to burnt clutch
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Clutch slipping or burning
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Flush torque converter thoroughly with non-lead gasoline/kerosene and torque converter oil

troubleshooting.symptom: Oil distributor seal ring to ring groove clearance excessive
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn seal ring or distributor groove
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace seal ring or oil distributor assembly if clearance is outside 0.04 to 0.16 mm (0.0016 to 0.0063 in)

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine does not start in 'N', 'P' ranges.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Faulty ignition switch/starter motor, range select linkage out of adjustment, or defective inhibitor switch and wiring.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check ignition switch and starter motor (1), range select linkage (2), inhibitor switch and wiring (3).

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine starts in other range than 'N' and 'P'.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Range select linkage misadjusted or defective/misadjusted inhibitor switch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check range select linkage (1), inhibitor switch and wiring (2).

troubleshooting.symptom: Sharp shock in shifting from 'N' to 'D' range.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Excessive engine stall rpm, high engine idling rpm, faulty rear lubrication, or defective rear clutch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check engine stall rpm (1), engine idling rpm (2), rear lubrication (3), governor valve (4), rear clutch (5).

troubleshooting.symptom: Vehicle will not run in 'D' range (but runs in '2', '1' and 'R' ranges).
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Range select linkage out of adjustment, low throttle oil pressure, manual control valve defect, or slipping transmission one-way clutch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check range select linkage (1), throttle oil pressure (2), manual control valve (3), one-way clutch of transmission (4).

troubleshooting.symptom: Vehicle will not run in 'D', '1', '2' ranges (but runs in 'R' range). Clutch slips. Very poor acceleration.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Low oil level, range select linkage, transmission air check leakage, engine idling rpm, rear lubrication, band servo, ignition/starter, rear clutch slipping, or defective oil pump.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), linkage (2), transmission air check (3), idling rpm (4), rear lubrication (5), band servo (6), ignition (7), rear clutch (8), oil pump (9).

troubleshooting.symptom: Vehicle will not run in 'R' range (but runs in 'D', '2' and '1' ranges). Clutch slips. Very poor acceleration.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Oil level, linkage, idling rpm, air check, rear lubrication, band servo, low & reverse brake slipping, front clutch slipping, rear clutch slipping, oil passage leakage, transmission one-way clutch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), linkage (2), idling rpm (3), air check (4), rear lubrication (5), band servo (6), low & reverse brake (7), front clutch (8), rear clutch (9), oil passage leakage (10), transmission one-way clutch (11).

troubleshooting.symptom: Vehicle will not run in any range.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Low oil level, range select linkage, engine idling rpm, air check, rear lubrication, band servo, low and reverse brake, oil pump, or torque converter one-way clutch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), linkage (2), engine idling rpm (3), air check (4), rear lubrication (5), band servo (6), low and reverse brake (7), oil pump (8), torque converter one-way clutch (9).

troubleshooting.symptom: Vehicle runs in 'N' range.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Range select linkage misadjusted, transmission air check failure, rear lubrication issue, or seized rear clutch.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check range select linkage (1), air check (2), rear lubrication (3), rear clutch (4).

troubleshooting.symptom: Maximum speed not attained. Acceleration poor.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Low oil level, linkage, air check, idling rpm, throttle oil pressure, governor valve, rear lubrication, engine adjustment/brakes, band brake, low & reverse brake, rear clutch, front clutch, oil pump.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Perform checks in sequence: oil level (1), linkage (2), air check (3), idling rpm (4), throttle pressure (5), governor (6), rear lubrication (7), brakes (8), band brake (9), low/rev brake (10), rear clutch (11), front clutch (12), oil pump (13).

troubleshooting.symptom: Failure to change gear from '2nd' to '3rd'.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Range select linkage, vacuum diaphragm/piping, kickdown switch/solenoid, air check, rear lubrication, manual control valve, band servo, governor valve, band brake, oil passage leakage.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check linkage (1), vacuum diaphragm (2), kickdown solenoid (3), air check (4), rear lubrication (5), manual valve (6), band servo (7), governor valve (8), band brake (9), oil passage leakage (10).

troubleshooting.symptom: Failure to change gear from '1st' to '2nd'.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Linkage, vacuum diaphragm, downshift solenoid, air check, rear lubrication, manual valve, band servo, governor valve, band brake, oil passage leakage, front clutch check ball.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Follow inspection sequence: linkage (1), vacuum diaphragm (2), downshift solenoid (3), air check (4), rear lubrication (5), manual valve (6), band servo (7), governor valve (8), band brake (9), oil passage leakage (10), front clutch check ball (11).

troubleshooting.symptom: Too high a gear change point from '1st' to '2nd', from '2nd' to '3rd'.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Vacuum diaphragm and piping, downshift solenoid/kickdown switch, throttle oil pressure, air check, rear lubrication, manual control valve, oil passage leakage.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check vacuum diaphragm/piping (1), kickdown switch/solenoid (2), throttle pressure (3), air check (4), rear lubrication (5), manual valve (6), oil passage leakage (7).

troubleshooting.symptom: Transmission overheats.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Incorrect oil level, rear lubrication failure, throttle oil pressure, engine stall rpm, oil quantity, manual control valve, air check, band servo, clutches/brakes slipping, planetary gear binding.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), rear lubrication (2), throttle pressure (3), stall rpm (4), oil quantity (5), manual valve (6), air check (7), band servo (8), clutches/brakes (9-14), planetary gear (15).

troubleshooting.symptom: Oil shoots out during operation. White smoke emitted from exhaust pipe during operation.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Punctured vacuum diaphragm absorbing ATF into engine intake, excessive oil level, or restricted oil cooler circuits.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), rear lubrication (2), vacuum diaphragm and piping (3), oil quantity (4), throttle pressure (5), stall rpm (6), manual valve (7), air check (8), clutches/brakes (9-14), planetary gear (15).

troubleshooting.symptom: Offensive smell at oil charging pipe.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Burnt clutch facings or brake band friction linings due to severe slippage or low fluid level.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), air check (2), inspect rear clutch (3), front clutch (4), band brake (5), low & reverse brake (6), oil pump (7), oil passages (8), torque converter one-way clutch (9), planetary gear (10).

troubleshooting.symptom: Transmission noise in 'P' and 'N' ranges.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Oil level low, incorrect engine idling rpm, or defective oil pump.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), engine idling rpm (2), oil pump (3).

troubleshooting.symptom: Transmission noise in 'D', '2', '1' and 'R' ranges.
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Oil level, engine idling rpm, rear clutch, oil pump, torque converter one-way clutch, front clutch check ball.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check oil level (1), idling rpm (2), rear clutch (3), oil pump (4), torque converter one-way clutch (5), front clutch check ball (6).
